# One-tile economics per product (generated by tools/tile_economics_30d.py --write)

Convention: next plant is sown on the harvest day (cycle days = plant age at harvest)

- plants: one plant life, planting to harvest; ongoing crops are also dug out (DIG) to free the tile
- animals: 30-day cycle, FEED+CARE every day (days 0-28), COLLECT_FERTILIZER days 1-29, feed wheat bought at 25, fertilizer sold at the flat start price 100, leftovers collected and sold on day 29
- warning: real fertilizer price falls from 100 to 1-30 over a game (top-game data), so the animal fertilizer revenue at a flat 100 is optimistic
